#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
umask 077
normwhole_root=$FNIT
source "$normwhole_root/logs/recon_runtime_env_20261009.sh"
normwhole_case="$1"; normwhole_gpu="$2"; normwhole_cores="$3"
normwhole_source="$normwhole_root/workspaces/recon_e2e_gcsa_remesh_79a41cdd_20261010_v1"
normwhole_run="$normwhole_root/runs/recon_e2e_gcsa_remesh_79a41cdd_20261010_v1"
export PYTHONPATH="$normwhole_source/src:$normwhole_source/tools"
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$normwhole_gpu" PYTORCH_NO_CUDA_MEMORY_CACHING=1
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 MKL_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=4
export NUMBA_CACHE_DIR="$normwhole_run/sub${normwhole_case}-numba-cache"
export PYTHONFAULTHANDLER=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
# 原始T1与空目录；Gibbs/remesh复用完整已验有序实现，不读取官方参考。
taskset -c "$normwhole_cores" "$FNIT_RECON_ENV/bin/python" -X faulthandler -u  "$normwhole_source/tools/benchmark_recon_torch_end_to_end.py"  --t1 "$normwhole_root/workspaces/recon_torch_surface_20261009/public_inputs_v1/raw_t1/sub${normwhole_case}_ses-test_T1w.nii.gz"  --output-root "$normwhole_run/sub$normwhole_case-candidate"  --weights-dir "$FNIT_RECON_RESOURCES/weights" --assets-dir "$FNIT_RECON_RESOURCES/assets"  --native-bin-dir "$FNIT_RECON_RESOURCES/native/bin" --device cuda:0 --threads 4  --hemisphere-workers 2 --native-optimizations auto --wm-backend native --wm-edit-backend native  --defects-backend native --sphere-normals-backend numba --n4-backend native  --gca-execution isolated --gca-inverse-backend torch --gca-candidate-chunk 1024 --fill-backend torch-numba  --normalization-controls-backend torch --normalization-initial-bias-backend torch --inflate-backend torch --mni-execution parallel-late --sphere-finish-backend torch --annotation-gibbs-backend numba --remesh-scalar-storage python  --code-version "79a41cdd:raw-T1:native-N4+ordered-Gibbs-numba+remesh-double-python;archive=e0a9a418669035f39f979e25cfb4b65e8cc93e200485eae7d93a2d22ddcfcaec"  > "$normwhole_run/sub$normwhole_case-candidate.launch.log" 2>&1
normwhole_rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$normwhole_rc" > "$normwhole_run/sub$normwhole_case-candidate.exit_code.txt"
